purpose: Proposed semantic decisions for feature candidate discovery and proposal

decisions.statement: An evidence cluster is a bounded set of source mechanics (functions, modules) with coherent responsibility semantics
Every proposal retains complete lineage to its source facts: file, line, symbol, mechanic type
Identical proposals from different evidence paths are deduplicated; the deduplication is explicit
All proposals begin with lifecycle PROPOSED; they never automatically advance to ADMITTED without explicit review
LLM inference results are recorded as INFERRED_NOT_ADMITTED; inference never admits features or changes proposal lifecycle

proposalStrategy.minimumEvidenceThreshold: At least one responsibility evidence cluster
proposalStrategy.rankingStrategy: Cluster size (number of mechanics), clustering cohesion, reachability from CLI
proposalStrategy.deduplicationScope: Within same workspace; proposals from different workspaces are distinct

failureHandling.handlingStrategy: Report that no candidates were found; suggest running analysis on larger scope
Proposals are still generated from static evidence; inference step is optional and skipped
Record which proposals were evaluated; skip remaining and output partial results
Include both duplicates; flag in proposal metadata for manual deduplication

inferenceEvaluation.purpose: Observational discovery only; does not change proposal lifecycle or admit features
evaluationQuestions: Does this evidence cluster represent a coherent feature?
inferenceEvaluation.confidenceTracking: Record model confidence but do not use for filtering

nextSteps: Run feature-coverage.unresolved-clusters query to extract evidence
